notes: Discovery universe is all tradable long U.S. equities with a current price greater than $0 and strictly below $10.00. Do not add arbitrary market-cap, sector, exchange, minimum-volume, minimum-price, watchlist, or momentum requirements at discovery. Scanner filters rank and prioritize candidates; they do not define the universe. Tradability, stale-data, spread, liquidity, Level 2, and deterministic risk checks may reject a candidate after discovery.
